queryLimitations: Complete means the observed query result was acquired, not that every relevant publication was identified. Topic cohorts overlap and are not added to the fixed six-journal trend denominator.
The perishable-inventory export contains 2,000 rows but 1,999 distinct records, against 3,911 reported results. The unexported portion remains pending.
There are 42 source-record discrepancies between reported reference counts and exported reference lines across the acquired sets; these are retained for review.
Search-defined cohorts require relevance and model-assumption screening. The 2026 publication year is incomplete.
